scope: Analysis only. No application source, Prompt18, catalog artifact, or provider was changed by this investigation. No external AI was called.
finding: Low-zoom overview tile generation independently simplifies/culls operational cell polygons and leaves uncovered land. This defect was reproduced from the admitted exact MNG geometry and actual PBF files.
screenshotLimit: The supplied screenshot's exact camera, loaded tile zooms and session history were not captured. The data defect is established; parent-tile fallback and the reason CHN appears more complete remain conditional explanations for this particular frame.
mechanism: POLICY uses geojson-vt tolerance 3 and extent 4096. Each cell polygon is an independent feature.
geojson-vt removes sub-threshold rings and simplifies vertices; the project additionally removes degenerate tile polygons.
Neighbor cells do not expand to cover a removed cell, so source land becomes an empty region in the overview PBF.
The map has a sea-colored background and no coverage-preserving country underlay in this rendering path, so empty regions show sea color.
Missing feature-state alone uses a gray fill fallback and does not explain the sea-colored holes.
MapLibre can retain loaded parent tiles while desired child tiles are unavailable. This can enlarge low-zoom defects during delayed loading, but occurrence in the supplied frame is unverified.
verificationGap: Generation and verification accumulate surviving cell IDs across all zooms. A cell appearing at a higher zoom satisfies that aggregate coverage check even when lower zooms omit it. Per-zoom land coverage is not established by the current check.

recommendedFix.preferred: Use coverage-preserving country/land overview geometry at low zoom, plus authoritative exact overlays for changed ownership/control and detail. Preserve runtime ownership/control semantics and avoid loading the whole world's exact cells.
recommendedFix.alternative: Use shared-boundary, coverage-preserving mesh simplification and explicit tiny-face handling instead of deleting independent land cells.
recommendedFix.avoidAsFinalFix: Setting tolerance to zero alone: it retains substantially more work, can worsen the performance problem, and still does not preserve every cell after quantization/degeneracy filtering.
validation: Compare land coverage at each supported zoom against the pinned reference with documented geometric tolerances, not merely an all-zoom ID union.
Check low zoom, zoom transitions, delayed tile loads, country selection and detail replacement.
Check authoritative ownership/control updates and undo/redo over the overview underlay.
Measure performance alongside correctness using the existing scripted provider.
recommendedFix.relationshipToPlannedWork: This belongs with the Prompt18 rendering/performance design and its regression checks. Replacing KOR/PRK natural subdivision boundaries later does not repair the worldwide overview culling defect. No prompt or implementation was modified here.
